h1: A product recommendation strategy for your store
overview: Before adding a recommendation widget, it helps to know where suggestions will earn their place. We review your store, your catalog and your best selling paths, then write a plan that says what to show on the home page, product pages, cart and emails, and why. You also get a comparison of suitable tools for your platform and budget, with a simple order of work, so every step has a clear reason.

faq: Which store platforms do you plan for?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix and similar platforms. We compare tools that work on your platform, and we are not tied to any vendor. Send your store link and we confirm what is possible.
Do I need much data for this to work?
More orders help suggestions improve, but a small store can still use simple rules, such as same collection or best seller. We explain what works at your size, so you do not buy tools you cannot use.
Do you install the widgets as well?
Not in this service. It delivers the plan. The Related Products, Cart Recommendations and other services on this page can be ordered to build the placements the plan recommends.
We cannot promise that. Well placed suggestions often help shoppers find items faster, but results depend on your products and traffic. The plan includes simple measures to test and learn.
